candidates.name: Boxing Ring (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP — scene dressing, not a lineup character. By Zaw Imagineering. 824 tris, 30 meshes, 4 flat-color materials. Normalized to a 2x2x2 cube centered at origin: scale 2.6 gives a 5.2u footprint (matches RingSim radius 2.6 diameter) with yOffset +2.6 putting the base at 0; canvas top lands ~+5.2u — likely wants a non-uniform squash (e.g. scale.y ~0.6) so fighters aren't on a tower. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'Zaw Imagineering via poly.pizza'.

candidates.name: Boxing Gloves pair (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP. By Zsky. Two named meshes RBoxingGloves1 + LBoxingGloves1 — could decorate the ring or be split for NPC gloves. 800 tris, 4 flat materials (upper/lower per glove) — recolor via material.color for house coral. Authored microscopic (0.002u): scale 250 -> ~0.5u glove pair; yOffset +0.25 grounds it. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'Zsky via poly.pizza'.

candidates.name: Punching Bag freestanding (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP. By Zsky. Freestanding bag on base+bar (3 named parts), 300 tris, 3 flat materials. Long axis is +Z (authored Z-up): rotate -90deg X to stand upright, or treat scale as needs-review. scale 45 -> ~0.8u along Z. Centered origin.
